name: USAAF 63-foot Rescue Boat
blurb: A Hangar-only twin-screw air-sea rescue launch with turning propellers and steerable rudders.
history: Fast rescue launches supported downed aircrew recovery around wartime operating areas. The sixty-three-foot class identity is documented in a U.S. transfer record; the beam, deckhouse and fittings here remain estimates pending a primary builder's plan.

sources.title: Congressional Record, transfer of 63-foot aircraft rescue boats
